reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, as it correctly identifies grain boundary stabilization by nano-oxides as a key mechanism for improving high-temperature ductility in ODS tungsten, though it slightly overstates the role of grain boundary sliding in this temperature regime.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive, but the requirement for simultaneous in-situ TEM/EBSD during high-temperature mechanical testing is extremely challenging and may be impractical, weakening the feasibility of the test as written.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful, as it addresses a critical knowledge gap for fusion materials and proposes a well-controlled comparison that, if tested, would provide valuable mechanistic insight into ductility improvement.
